description: Configure VSCode to debug a Python Flask application running in Docker container. DETAILED STEPS: (1) Install debugpy in the running container using: 'docker exec flask_debug_app pip install debugpy'. (2) Modify /home/ga/workspace/flask_docker_project/app/main.py to add 'import debugpy' at the top and 'debugpy.listen(("0.0.0.0", 5678))' before the 'app.run()' line (around line 25). (3) Edit /home/ga/workspace/flask_docker_project/docker-compose.yml to expose port 5678 by adding '- "5678:5678"' under the ports section (after the 5000:5000 line). (4) Restart the container by running 'cd /home/ga/workspace/flask_docker_project && docker-compose down && docker-compose up -d' to apply the port changes. (5) Create /home/ga/workspace/flask_docker_project/.vscode/launch.json with a Python attach configuration: type='python', request='attach', port=5678, host='localhost', and pathMappings with localRoot='${workspaceFolder}/app' and remoteRoot='/app'. (6) The container name is 'flask_debug_app' and the Flask app runs on port 5000. The debugpy debug port must be 5678. Use 'docker exec', 'docker-compose', and VSCode file editing to complete the task.
